scheme: Micro Irrigation Scheme (drip & sprinkler) under PMKSY
scheme_tamil: நுண்ணீர் பாசனத் திட்டம் (சொட்டு நீர் / தெளிப்பு நீர்)
benefit: 100% subsidy for small and marginal farmers (up to 2 ha); 75% subsidy for other farmers (up to 5 ha); the 12% GST on micro irrigation systems is borne by the Tamil Nadu Government
eligibility: All farmers; small/marginal farmer certificate needed for 100% subsidy
how_to_apply: Register on the MIMIS portal / tnhorticulture.tn.gov.in:8080/Subsidy/ApplySubsidy with Aadhaar, family card, patta, crop details, small/marginal certificate and bank details
year_status: Implemented since 2007-08; Agriculture Budget 2025-26 allotted Rs 1,168 crore for 3 lakh acres

scheme: Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agriculture Development Programme (KAVIADP)
scheme_tamil: கலைஞரின் அனைத்து கிராம ஒருங்கிணைந்த வேளாண் வளர்ச்சித் திட்டம்
department: Agriculture–Farmers Welfare (with Rural Development and other departments)
benefit: Converges schemes of all departments in selected village panchayats: bringing fallow land under cultivation, inputs, machinery, water harvesting; AED components carry 100% subsidy or the pattern of dovetailed Union schemes (SMAM, NADP, PM-KUSUM, PMKSY)
eligibility: All farmers of the selected village panchayats
how_to_apply: Enrol through the Uzhavan mobile app or the local Assistant Agricultural Officer
year_status: Launched 23 May 2022 (Rs 227 crore, 1,997 village panchayats); final phase 2025-26 covers 2,338 gram panchayats at Rs 269.50 crore

scheme: Chief Minister's Mannuyir Kaathu Mannuyir Kaappom Scheme (soil health)
scheme_tamil: முதலமைச்சரின் மண்ணுயிர் காத்து மன்னுயிர் காப்போம் திட்டம்
benefit: Soil health and organic inputs such as green manure seed distribution
eligibility: Farmers across Tamil Nadu
how_to_apply: Through the Agriculture Extension Centre / Uzhavan app
year_status: Introduced 2024-25 with Rs 178 crore benefiting about 21.35 lakh farmers; continued in 2025-26 and listed as a flagship scheme for 2026-27

scheme: Chief Minister's Farmers' Welfare Service Centres
benefit: 1,000 one-stop service centres; agriculture graduates get 30% capital subsidy (Rs 3 lakh on a Rs 10 lakh unit, Rs 6 lakh on a Rs 20 lakh unit) plus training at KVK / Farmers Training Centre
eligibility: Agriculture / allied graduates willing to run a centre
how_to_apply: Apply to the district Joint Director of Agriculture / Deputy Director of Horticulture
year_status: Announced in Agriculture Budget 2025-26

scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) – crop insurance
benefit: Insurance cover for notified crops against yield loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases
eligibility: Loanee and non-loanee farmers including tenant cultivators growing notified crops in notified areas
how_to_apply: Enrol through cooperative societies, banks, CSCs or the PMFBY portal before the crop-wise cut-off date
year_status: Implemented from Kharif 2016 in all districts except Chennai; farmer-ID requirement relaxed for 2025-26 samba/navarai; Kharif 2026-27 notified; TN Agriculture Budget 2026-27 allots Rs 648.55 crore for crop insurance (36 lakh acres, ~15 lakh farmers)

scheme: PM-KUSUM Component B – standalone solar pumpsets
scheme_tamil: பிரதம மந்திரி குசும் – சூரிய சக்தி பம்பு செட்
benefit: Total 70% subsidy on standalone solar pumps (State 40% + Centre 30%); farmer pays the balance
eligibility: Farmers with own land and water source; first come, first served
how_to_apply: Apply through the Agricultural Engineering Department / pmkusum.tn.gov.in
year_status: Targets: 17,000 standalone pumps (AED) and 20,000 grid-connected pumps (TEDA/TANGEDCO)

benefit: Promotes chemical-free organic agriculture, bio-inputs, certification and markets; high-level committee chaired by the Chief Secretary reviews progress
eligibility: Organic farmers, FPOs, entrepreneurs
how_to_apply: Through the Agriculture Department and Tamil Nadu Organic Certification Department
year_status: Released 14 March 2023 for five years; TN had 31,629 ha under organic farming (14th in India) and exported 4,223 MT worth Rs 108 crore in 2020-21

benefit: Crop loans waived up to Rs 75,000 per eligible farmer; additional Rs 2,842.77 crore released when the scheme was expanded
eligibility: Farmers who took crop loans from cooperative societies between 1 May 2025 and 31 March 2026 (as reported)
how_to_apply: Automatic through the lending cooperative society
year_status: Announced 2026 by the new State Government

benefit: 50% subsidy on farm machinery/implements for SC/ST, small, marginal and women farmers (lower rate for others); custom hiring centres; AED machinery can be hired through the e-Vaadagai app
eligibility: All farmers (higher subsidy for SC/ST, small, marginal and women farmers)
how_to_apply: Pre-register required machinery on the e-Vaadagai / AED portal
year_status: TN Agriculture Budget 2026-27: Rs 227.20 crore benefiting 24,000 farmers

benefit: 100% subsidy for creating farm ponds in individual farmers' fields to store rain water
eligibility: Individual farmers in project areas
how_to_apply: Apply to the Assistant Executive Engineer (AED) of the block
year_status: Ongoing

benefit: Farmers sell fruits and vegetables directly to consumers without middlemen; daily prices fixed by the market
eligibility: Registered farmers (identity card issued by the market)
how_to_apply: Contact the Agricultural Officer of the Uzhavar Sandhai / Deputy Director (Agri Business)
year_status: First market opened at Madurai on 14 November 1999; 103 markets opened in 1999-2000

benefit: Area expansion, demonstrations, seed and processing support for minor millets
eligibility: Millet growers
how_to_apply: Through the block Agriculture Extension Centre
year_status: Five-year mission 2023-24 to 2027-28; Rs 65.30 crore in 2024-25; Rs 63.81 crore (Union + State) in 2026-27

benefit: Subsidy to farmers registering seed farms to produce 7,730 MT of certified paddy seed supplied to TN State Seed Development Agency
eligibility: Farmers who register paddy seed farms with the Department
how_to_apply: Register seed farm with the block Agriculture office
year_status: 2026-27: Rs 34.72 crore from State funds after the Centre discontinued its paddy seed support

scheme: Special scheme for SC and ST cultivators
scheme_tamil: ஆதிதிராவிடர் மற்றும் பழங்குடியின விவசாயிகளுக்கான சிறப்புத் திட்டம்
benefit: Additional 20% subsidy so SC/ST small and marginal farmers can meet the beneficiary contribution under capital-intensive schemes; irrigation infrastructure
eligibility: SC and ST farmers
how_to_apply: Through the Agriculture Extension Centre
year_status: 2026-27: Rs 56.72 crore from State funds

benefit: AI / machine-learning based real-time, personalised advisories for farmers
eligibility: All farmers
how_to_apply: Mobile app (to be launched)
year_status: 2026-27: Rs 2 crore

benefit: Protecting soil fertility across the State
eligibility: Farmers
how_to_apply: Through the Agriculture Department

benefit: Inputs and assistance for kuruvai paddy; extended in 2026-27 to non-delta paddy farmers
eligibility: Paddy cultivators (delta and, from 2026-27, non-delta)
how_to_apply: Through the Agriculture Extension Centre
year_status: 2024: Rs 78.67 crore; Revised Budget 2026-27: Rs 134 crore

benefit: Subsidy of 50% of cost or Rs 70 per hectare, whichever is less
eligibility: All farmers; 24% of benefits for SC/ST and 20% for women farmers
how_to_apply: Assistant Agricultural Officer (village) / Joint Director of Agriculture (district)
year_status: Listed on myScheme

benefit: Rs 4,000 per 1-hectare demonstration plot
eligibility: Maize farmers in selected districts; preference to small, marginal, SC/ST and women farmers
how_to_apply: Assistant Agricultural Officer / Joint Director of Agriculture
year_status: Listed on myScheme

scheme: Seed Multiplication Scheme (paddy, millets, pulses, oilseeds, cotton)
benefit: Subsidy for producing seeds under contract with the Department of Agriculture
eligibility: Tamil Nadu farmers who produce and supply seed on contract
how_to_apply: Register the seed farm with the Department
year_status: Listed on myScheme

benefit: Holistic horticulture development; vegetable seed kits, vegetable garden kits and nutritive garden kits for homesteads
eligibility: All districts, focus on non-NHM districts (homestead kits in all districts except Nilgiris)
how_to_apply: Register on TNHORTNET / Assistant Director of Horticulture
year_status: Ongoing

benefit: 40% subsidy for area expansion of hybrid vegetables (Rs 20,000/ha); 40–50% assistance across NHM, NADP, IHDS and TN-IAMP components
eligibility: Horticulture farmers in NHM districts
how_to_apply: Online registration on TNHORTNET
year_status: Ongoing

scheme: Tamil Nadu Irrigated Agriculture Modernization Project (TN-IAMP)
department: Water Resources + Agriculture, Horticulture, AED, TNAU and others
benefit: Tank rehabilitation and climate-resilient irrigated agriculture in selected sub-basins
eligibility: Farmers in the 66 project sub-basins
how_to_apply: Through line departments in the sub-basin
year_status: World Bank loan of US$318 million (2017); ~4,778 tanks, 5,43,000 ha command area

scheme: Price Support Scheme – Green gram procurement (Rabi 2025-26)
benefit: Procurement of green gram at MSP through NAFED
eligibility: Green gram growers of notified areas
how_to_apply: Through procurement centres notified in the Gazette
year_status: G.O. Ms. No. 65, Agriculture–Farmers Welfare (AP4), 13 March 2026

benefit: Grant support for start-ups in agriculture, livestock or fisheries
eligibility: Agri-tech start-ups
how_to_apply: As per the call issued by the Department
year_status: Government Order dated 10 June 2025

benefit: Support for entrepreneurs and companies setting up agro value-addition and processing units
eligibility: Entrepreneurs, companies, FPOs
how_to_apply: Through the Department's notification/tender
year_status: Announced in Agriculture Budget 2025-26 and notified later in 2025
